<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks at 134.30, 131.90, 128.20 (two peaks), and 127.40 (two peaks) fall in the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110–160 ppm). Counting each carbon represented by these peaks gives 6 aromatic carbons. The remaining peak at 168.20 ppm corresponds to a carbonyl carbon, not aromatic.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
